scope: Which kind of process each arm count suits, read off the line before proposing anything
what_this_does_not_give: any takt, reach or interference result
a verdict on OP040 onward, whose motion the checkpoint calls roughly modelled only
anything about cost, safety or maintainability

OP020.why: 右腕がトレイの取っ手を掴んだまま、左腕が作業する。OP030-A と同じ形

verified_from_an_authored_sequence.note: Two arms being installed is not the same as two being required. These are the stations outside OP030 whose own sequence says one arm holds while the other works. OP010 has no authoring script committed, and OP040 onward the checkpoint calls roughly modelled only, so neither is verified either way.

op030_substations.A: 片手で供給から運び、そのまま押さえる。もう片手が締結 — 人の両手仕事
op030_substations.B: 両手で同一ケーブルの両端。旋回しながら曲げる — 人の両手仕事
op030_substations.C: M6 と M14 を別腕に載せ、端子は直列 — 人なら工具を持ち替える片手仕事
op030_substations.C_is_the_exception: C の 2 本目は「もう一方の手」ではなく「工具を持ち替えないための手」である。だから C は対を分けても失うものが最も少ない

ladder.person: 片手、あるいは手を使わない
ladder.suits: 検査・計測。部品を取らず、嵌めず、締めない
ladder.example: OP090・OP100（ストッカも操作盤も無い）

ladder.points: 1 を押さえて 1 に作用
ladder.person: 両手。人の標準的な組立動作
ladder.suits: 部品を保持しないと定まらず、別の工具で作用する工程
ladder.example: OP030-A（押さえ＋M4 締結）ほかライン 8 工程

ladder.person: 両手。柔軟物を扱うときの人の動作
ladder.suits: 柔軟物の 2 点を同時に。片方だけでは形が決まらない
ladder.example: OP030-B（ケーブル両端を持ち、旋回しながら曲げる）

ladder.points: 1 を押さえて 2 に同時作用
ladder.suits: 同時締結など、順番に作用すると結果が変わる工程
1 工程に独立な作業点が 2 つある、または工程内で先行準備を回す
ladder.example: ライン上に無い（OP030-A の支持部 2 個がこの形）

finding: The line answers it as built: 8 stations with two arms, 2 with one, none with more. The single-armed pair is also the pair that takes no parts and has no operator panel -- inspection. So two arms is what picking a part up and fitting it costs, and one arm is what looking at it costs. Three and four are not on the line at all: they are not a person's shape, and the case for them has to be made from what they parallelise rather than from what a person does. Where a sequence can be read, two-handed is the rule and not the exception: OP020 holds a tray by its handle with one arm for 63 of its 68 seconds while the other works, which is OP030-A's pattern. Of the four sub-stations whose own sequence is committed, three need two arms and only C does not.
